summary: CLI-derived nItems constructs the CSR slices; device setup uploads values, columns, row delimiters, and vector. The selected kernel grid is bounded but its warp-per-row loop advances row by gridDim.x*8 until row<numRows; each lane walks rowStart+lane through rowEnd by 32, multiplies every addressed value/vector entry, shuffles the partial sum, and lane 0 stores. Main performs an additional synchronized warmup, then compiled main loops over the requested count, calls the CUDA launch stub on every trip, records/synchronizes completion, and copies output after timing.
